## Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers

(d) Celanese Corporation (the "Company") is filing this amendment to its Current Report on Form 8-K filed on April 20, 2026, which reported the election of Anne P. Noonan to the Board of Directors (the "Board") of the Company. At the time of her election, the Board had not determined her appointments to any committees of the Board.

On October 15, 2026, the Board appointed Ms. Noonan to its Compensation and Management Development Committee and its Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, effective immediately.
